why: A (universes 0): for a slice submanifold N ⊆ V and the induced connection (X ⊢ Y)_q = P_q(dY_q(X_q)) (project-defined covAt/leviCivita on maps N → V), Milnor's rules: (1) smooth for smooth tangent X and smooth Y, (2) additivity in X and in Y (Y differentiable at q), (3) (fX) ⊢ Y = f(X ⊢ Y), (4) Leibniz for f, Y differentiable at q with X, Y tangent at q. B: for EVERY smooth Mathlib CovariantDerivative on an abstract ℝⁿ-manifold, (a) rules (1)-(4) and (b) in every chart of the maximal atlas there are Christoffel symbols Γ smooth on the chart image with (X ⊢ Y)ᵏ = Σ Xⁱ ∂ᵢYᵏ + Σ Γᵏᵢⱼ XⁱYʲ. A ⇒ B fails genuinely: A is about one specific connection on embedded submanifolds and does not mention Mathlib's CovariantDerivative; (a) would follow from Mathlib's axioms directly (as in V6_3's A_to_B_rules), but (b) — locality/tensoriality of an arbitrary connection in a chart, defining Γ by applying it to chart-coordinate fields extended to global smooth fields, and smoothness of Γ — is in neither the project (Connection.lean: 'no Christoffel symbols') nor Mathlib. B ⇒ A holds only vacuously: A is re-proved from the project's contMDiff_tanProj, contMDiff_dN_apply, dN_add, dN_smul; B cannot specialize to the project's leviCivita, which is not packaged as a Mathlib CovariantDerivative.
B_issue: B's M need not be Hausdorff; extracting Christoffel symbols in a chart from global smooth fields needs bump functions, standard only for Hausdorff manifolds (Mathlib's leibniz-locality via indicator functions may suffice, but this was not checked).
overlap: B_to_A: 105 shared — contMDiff_tanProj, contMDiff_dN_apply, dN_add, dN_smul and their slice-chart/gram-projection infrastructure (the project's own proofs re-done)
embedded_special_case_note: Items/V6_4.lean, namespace Emb. B_emb := B at M = Bridge.Sub hN (model ℝⁿ), cov = Bridge.conn (B_to_B_emb via Bridge.conn_contMDiff): (a) IsMilnorRules (nab conn) and (b) Christoffel symbols of conn in every chart of the maximal atlas of ↥N. Proved Emb.isMilnorRules_iff: (a) ⇔ TanRules hN (Milnor's rules, in B's form, for Morse.leviCivita on smooth tangent maps N → V), via Bridge.amb_conn, contMDiff_section_iff and the bijection X ↦ amb X (Emb.exists_amb, amb_injective). Hence A_to_B_emb_rules (A ⇒ part (a); uses all five theorems of A, the constant-scalar rules from smul_left/smul_right with f constant) and B_to_A_tan (B ⇒ A restricted to smooth tangent fields, model ℝⁿ); both #rt_check OK; overlap of B_to_A_tan: 92 slice-chart/Gram-projection infrastructure lemmas plus contMDiff_tanProj, none of dN_add/dN_smul/contMDiff_dN_apply. Not proved: A ⇒ part (b). The coordinate formula for the induced connection in an arbitrary chart e of the maximal atlas needs Γᵏᵢⱼ(u) = coordinates of P(∂ᵢ∂ⱼ(incl∘e⁻¹)(u)) pulled back by d(incl∘e⁻¹)_u, its smoothness on e.target, and chain rules for mfderiv e / mfderiv e⁻¹ — Christoffel symbols are not in the project or the Bridge (only slice charts are handled, Bridge.inCoordinates_conn); new geometry, stopped. What A has beyond B_emb: rules for non-tangent and merely differentiable Y, any model Z. Dictionary lemmas added (Emb): SF/SFn, sf_amb, isSmoothVF_of_sf, exists_amb, amb_injective, amb_nab (= Bridge.amb_conn for nab), amb_add/amb_smul/amb_fsmul, dirDeriv_eq (dirDeriv X f p = Morse.dN f p (amb X p), the ℝ-valued analogue of Bridge.dN_D), sf_add, sf_fsmul.
